title: Daedalus 7.0.x fails on older macOS due to notarization and dynamic libraries

summary.text: Maintainer investigation separated an installer notarization problem from a dynamic-library loading failure on older macOS; the official 7.1.0 release records the dynamic-library compatibility fix.

problem.text: On older macOS, Daedalus 7.0.1 or 7.0.2 may fail installation trust checks or fail to launch with incompatible libiconv/libcharset versions.

symptoms.text: Older macOS rejects or does not trust the 7.0.x installer notarization.
Launch logs contain an incompatible libiconv.dylib and libcharset.1.dylib version error.

user_phrases.text: Daedalus 7 not opening on old macOS

errors.verbatim: Incompatible library version: libiconv.dylib requires version 2.0.0 or later, but libcharset.1.dylib provides version 1.0.0
errors.normalized: incompatible library version libiconv requires 2.0.0 libcharset provides 1.0.0

daedalus.notes: Issue history covers 7.0.1 and 7.0.2; official 7.1.0 release documents the older-macOS dynamic-library fix.

causes.claim: Maintainer investigation found a missing notarization staple for the trust failure and a separate dynamic-library loading incompatibility on older macOS.

diagnostics.action: Confirm Daedalus 7.0.1 or 7.0.2 and an older macOS version, then look for the exact dynamic-library error in launch diagnostics.
diagnostics.why: The issue contains two separate failure modes and the release fix is scoped to older macOS dynamic-library loading.

resolutions.action: Install Daedalus 7.1.0 from the official release-linked download location, or consult the official release notes for the exact newer version under consideration.
resolutions.why: The official 7.1.0 release states that it resolves the older-macOS dynamic-library loading issue.

expected_outcome.text: Daedalus launches on the affected older macOS environment after using the officially released compatibility fix.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, or spending passwords.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

evidence.rationale: Maintainer diagnosis and user testing are followed by an official 7.1.0 release that documents the fix.

lifecycle.reason: Affected 7.0.x behavior is retained for users on those releases; fixed in 7.1.0.
